relationship.statement: Separate successor design. It does not modify S8-S11 protocols, results, thresholds, receipts, or dispositions.

research_statement: Existing delayed expert mixtures may fail under regime change because fixed score-to-weight rules cannot distinguish persistent expert skill from transient correlated errors. FREM-S12 proposes a causally delayed, stability-constrained router over multiscale Fourier-reservoir and engram-retrieval scenario laws; the mechanism predicts better joint probabilistic forecasts under repeated walk-forward shifts without relying on extra future information or an unfair compute advantage.
question: Does a learned causal memory router improve joint monthly return-distribution forecasts over the frozen S11 stacker and strong compute-matched non-memory baselines across repeated walk-forward folds?
falsification: Reject support if the candidate fails the practical energy-score margin against either mandatory control, degrades dependence scoring beyond its noninferiority margin, fails more than the allowed folds, violates compute matching, or depends on leakage, post-outcome tuning, omitted seeds, or invalid artifacts.

included: mechanism ablation, robustness, scaling, and efficiency
Kaggle CPU and GPU engineering qualification
Kaggle development execution after an exact freeze
excluded: protected confirmation before a separate freeze
claims of novelty, profitability, or state of the art before evidence

candidate_model.name: causal_multiscale_memory_router
candidate_model.inputs: train-only standardized causal return states and matured past proper-score feedback
candidate_model.fourier_reservoir: fixed random Fourier features feeding a spectrally normalized recurrent state; no future outcomes enter the state
candidate_model.engram_bank: bounded matured context/outcome records with short, medium, long, context-nearest and tail-regime retrieval laws
candidate_model.router: small causal neural gate trained only on matured specialist regret, state summaries and uncertainty features
constraints: feedback delay equal to label maturity
no evaluation-time parameter updates unless frozen as online adaptation
identical information set for candidate and controls
candidate_model.output: finite multivariate scenario law with retained scenario identities and mixture weights
candidate_model.policy_role: secondary diagnostic only; cannot rescue failure of the forecast endpoint

mandatory_controls: regularized VAR with matched residual scenario law
compute-matched neural sequence baseline selected before the final freeze

development_candidates: Kenneth French six size/book-to-market research portfolios
Kenneth French twenty-five size/book-to-market research portfolios
requirements: official source URLs and release timestamps
release-vintage or revision contract where available
no numeric protected-outcome inspection before freeze
data.claim_boundary: Research portfolios are not individual tradable securities or a deployable feed.

splits.purge: one complete forecast horizon plus all label and feedback maturity lag
splits.protected_confirmation: No confirmation dates or source may be opened until a later versioned freeze.

primary.statistical_unit: forecast origin with all contemporaneous portfolio dimensions retained jointly
mandatory_comparisons: candidate versus strongest predeclared non-FREM baseline
primary.uncertainty: paired hierarchical circular moving-block bootstrap by dataset family and fold; primary 12-month block, 10000 draws, fixed seed 1912; 6/24-month sensitivities descriptive
primary.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two mandatory comparisons
primary.fold_rule: pooled corrected interval above zero, at least 75 percent of eligible folds positive, and no dataset family with a materially negative pooled effect
primary.dependence_guard: variogram-score degradation no worse than 1 percent relative to each mandatory control
primary.decision: All primary and dependence conditions must pass; secondary wealth cannot override failure.

secondary: net-of-cost policy utility and wealth as non-rescuing diagnostics
runtime, peak memory, GPU utilization, energy proxy, parameter count and serialized state size

development.selection: nested chronological validation only; one candidate selected before the fixed development matrix
development.valid_failure_policy: Preserve and count failures; never omit a failing seed or fold.
development.scientific_runs: Only stages whose preceding gate passes are authorized; the existence of a preset does not authorize executing it.

matrix.core: selected candidate plus all mandatory controls over every admitted family, fold and final-matrix seed
robustness: return perturbation scaled from training data only
release revision stress where historical vintages exist

platform_assumptions_observed_2026_10_18.quota: Account- and demand-dependent; live receipt required before every launch.

development_ceiling.effective_limit: minimum of these ceilings, observed account quota and measured projection

kaggle.confirmation_ceiling: UNAUTHORIZED; proposed separately after a valid development result
kaggle.accelerator_policy: Use GPU only after a measured representative speedup and CPU/GPU numerical-equivalence gate; otherwise use CPU.
kaggle.isolation: Separate S12 threat model: private notebook, read-only attached inputs, internet disabled for scientific shards, exact hashes, environment fingerprint, no secrets, bounded writable output. This does not inherit or claim S10 bubblewrap equivalence.
kaggle.persistence: Save-and-run version plus downloaded output archive, producer/local SHA-256 agreement, cell ledger and explicit stopped-session receipt
kaggle.resume: Only exact checkpoint continuation within the same consumed shard; no new scientific retry after a valid completed result

compute_matching.information: identical causal inputs and label availability
compute_matching.search: same declared tuning opportunity or a reported disadvantage to the candidate
compute_matching.budget: matched wall-clock and accelerator class for learned controls; classical controls receive sufficient convergence budget
compute_matching.reporting: actual steps, parameters, wall time, peak memory, device utilization and failures

gates: G1 source, rights and contamination audit
G2 exact P0 model and experiment freeze
G5 Kaggle capability, environment and persistence qualification
G6 measured cost projection within live quota
G8 fixed full development matrix and independent saved-output audit
G9 separate confirmation freeze only after valid support
G10 independent reproduction, paper and release review

terminal_rules.negative_or_inconclusive: Close the frozen S12 version. A new mechanism requires S13 or a separately versioned successor.
terminal_rules.invalid: Record the validity defect and preserve the attempt; only a prospectively corrected freeze may run.
terminal_rules.positive_development: Development support only. No profitability, confirmation, deployment or publication claim.
terminal_rules.protected: No outcome-driven threshold, fold, block, seed, baseline, retry or dataset substitution.
